summary: Reference sheet for the Prep Officer (Launch Prep Officer), the launch-readiness specialist on the Patch Mission Control team. The sheet presents the character in launch-prep poses with Mission Control uniform and tools, intended for character continuity and downstream asset generation.

title_and_callouts: Title reads 'LAUNCH PREP OFFICER' with the tagline 'WE PREP THE PAYLOAD. YOU LAUNCH THE MISSION.'
Role at a glance: own launch readiness, verify systems and payload, coordinate final checks, confirm go/no-go, hand off to launch.
Responsibility steps: Plan and Review, Prep and Assemble, Systems Check, Final Kit Check, Go/No-Go, Hand Off and Launch.
Status indicators: Green Light (Clear and Green - Proceed to launch), Yellow Light (Standby), Red Light (Hold/Stop - Resolve and adjust).
character: Human Mission Control operator with a friendly, reliable, calm demeanor.
costume: Navy and light grey jumpsuit with visible patches and details.
Light underlayer visible at the collar.
Name tag and launch ID on the uniform.
props: Tablet, radio, launch tag, multi-tool, flashlight, tether strap, and utility pouch.
poses: Front view holding the launch clipboard.
Three-quarter view showing the side of the uniform and tools.
Side view showing profile details with hands by the sides.
color_notes: Navy blue and light grey uniform tones with white accents and details.
